title: Unsupervised Wrap-Discontinuity Repair in Wavetable Synthesis via Hybrid GA–PPO Meta-Search
summary: Wavetable oscillators click when the stored period does not join cleanly at the wrap. We treat that click as a local seam-repair problem and score repairs with a locked residual R_blend (seam match to a cliff-withheld ideal sibling, plus mid-cycle identity to the cracked engine). DenoiseOpt searches compact repair operators with a hybrid of genetic search, PPO, and population-based training; we reuse these search tools rather than proposing a new NAS or RL algorithm. Evidence is objective R_blend only (no listening tests). On a five-seed holdout, a short hybrid freeze reaches 0.9708 +/-…
